subject: Weekly runbook: fleet sizing & reserve runway for Kestrel AI (close window)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel weekly — pre-close sizing & reserve ask

Team —

Kestrel (KESTREL-452) is asking to finalize a Dedicated reserve run rate for their expected Q3 ramp. They pushed the close window to end of next week; sales asked for a firm sizing/readout for the contract deck tomorrow. Quick asks: 

- Laura: can you confirm the target committed slot $/month and the billing cadence they prefer? I want the ARR/tCO comparison for the deck.
- Ben/Karthik: what minimum pool (GPU slots) can we guarantee with current Q3 provisioning without impacting existing commitments? If we can't hit it, what are the fallback slots and latency impact?
- Mina: what burst capacity can we promise during onboarding (first 30 days)?

I've attached the projection workbook and a draft slot map. Please reply with short bullets — we have a 10:30am GTM review tomorrow.

Thanks,
Grace
Senior Sales Strategist
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kestrel_projection_q2.xlsx (xlsx), reserve_slot_map.png (image)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel weekly — pre-close sizing & reserve ask

Grace —

Short answers:
- Target commitment proposed in the deck: 120 reserved slots (p4-equivalent) at $58k/month net (volume tiered). I ran two scenarios in the attached tab: conservative (80 slots) and ramp (120 -> 200 over 6 months).
- Billing cadence: customer prefers monthly invoicing but will accept quarterly for contract reasons — we should offer quarterly discount in the doc.
- ARR/tCO: conservative gives ~ $1.06M ARR first year; ramp scenario ~ $1.8M. See sheet "ARR_summary".

I'll join the 10:30 GTM review with the workbook.

-Laura
Director, Sales Finance

Attachment referenced: kestrel_projection_q2.xlsx (see tabs: ARR_summary, pricing_scenarios)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel weekly — pre-close sizing & reserve ask

Grace / Laura —

Infra constraints and options:
- With current capacity plan we're green to guarantee 80 reserved p4-equivalent slots steady-state for Q3 without impacting existing committed customers.
- To hit 120 guaranteed, we'd need to pull forward one 32-GPU NPI cluster (estimated 3-week lead) or shift some burst capacity from the flexible pool, which will add ~6ms p95 latency for large gen workloads during peaks.
- Burst: we can offer up to 40 additional burst slots for first 30 days if we accept a 20% burst surcharge and schedule non-overlapping peak windows.

Fallback/mitigation: automatic routing to compatible quantized variants (no infra change) for non-critical paths; can set up canary to protect SLOs.

I'll coordinate with hardware ops if leadership approves the cluster pull-forward.

-Ben
Sr. Infrastructure Ops (Fleet)

Attachment: reserve_slot_map.png (visual of proposed slot allocation)
From: Dan Kim <dan.kim@kestrel.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Kestrel weekly — pre-close sizing & reserve ask

Thanks Grace / Laura / Ben —

Appreciate the quick answers. A couple clarifications from our side before the GTM call: 

1) On the 120-slot ramp: can Redwood commit to 120 steady-state by week 4 post-signature, with the first 30 days having up to +40 burst? That's important for our onboarding benchmarks.
2) If you need to pull the NPI cluster, will that change the start date in the contract (we prefer T+7 signing -> start)?
3) We want the option to request an extra dedicated region if needed (US-WEST fallback) — what's the lead time?

If you can answer 1 & 3 in short bullets today, we can finalize the SOW for docuSign.

Dan
Head of ML Platforms
Kestrel AI
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dan Kim <dan.kim@kestrel.ai>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, sarah.lopez@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Kestrel runbook decisions + next steps (final)

Team / Dan —

Recap and committed answers for the SOW:

- Commitment: Redwood will guarantee 120 reserved p4-equivalent slots within 4 weeks post-signature (T+28). We will enable +40 burst capacity for the first 30 days at a 20% surcharge. (Ben: action to file hardware pull request; Karthik: will prepare routing policy.)
- If we need to pull the NPI cluster to meet T+7 start, that will move the start date to T+21 for a safe handoff; we prefer T+28 to avoid risk. (Ben: confirm NPI impact and confirm earliest start in 24h.)
- US-WEST dedicated region: lead time 3–4 weeks to provision and validate; we can add as a fallback with a regional routing SLA in the SOW. (Mina: add burst/region language to contract addendum.)

Action items (owners + due):
- Ben: submit cluster pull-forward request and confirm earliest safe start (due: 2026-05-23 17:00 PDT).
- Laura: update pricing table to include quarterly option and burst surcharge line (due: 2026-05-22 19:00 PDT) — Laura already attached updated workbook.
- Karthik: prepare routing + canary policy doc for onboarding (due: 2026-05-24).
- Mina: draft contract addendum language for burst and regional fallback (attach to DocuSign) (due: 2026-05-23).
- Grace (me): finalize SOW and send DocuSign link once Ben confirms earliest start.

Dan: once we have Ben's confirmation, I'll send the DocuSign packet. If you want T+7, we can log it as an expedited request but it will show up as a premium change in the SOW.

Thanks all — short sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to close.

Best,
Grace
Senior Sales Strategist
Redwood Inference
